resources.coverage: Observed descendants including detached browser groups; sub-sampling-lifetime children and processes reparented before observation may be missed. CPU sums maximum observed process time per PID/start identity, preserving work when zombie accounting resets; it is not an exact kernel tree accounting. ps CPU precision is platform-dependent (centiseconds on macOS, whole seconds on the pinned Linux image). RSS is a concurrent sum, not summed per-process maxima.
